product.name: Laundry Management App
product.tagline: Track garments in, out, and washed; print tags, send ready SMS, and collect payment digitally

sections.problem_statement: Small-to-mid-sized laundry owners in India currently rely on manual paper ledgers and WhatsApp, leading to frequent garment loss, missed delivery deadlines, and chaotic payment reconciliation. Existing enterprise-grade ERPs are prohibitively expensive and complex, leaving a massive gap for a lightweight, mobile-first solution. This product simplifies the entire lifecycle—from digitized tagging to automated SMS updates—to reduce operational overhead by 40% and improve customer retention.
target_users: Rajesh Kumar, Store Owner, 'CleanExpress' Chain, struggles with inventory shrinkage and staff accountability for lost garments.
Sunita Devi, Front-desk Manager, Independent Laundry, spends 2 hours daily manually typing SMS updates to customers about order readiness.
Vikram Singh, Franchisee, Multi-outlet Laundry, lacks centralized visibility into daily cash flows and pending payments across his three branches.
user_stories: As a store owner, I want to generate unique QR-coded garment tags so that I can track each item through washing, ironing, and delivery stages to eliminate loss.
As a front-desk manager, I want to trigger automated SMS status updates so that customers stop calling to check on their orders, saving me 10+ hours per week.
As a shop owner, I want to integrate UPI/QR payment links into the digital invoice so that I can reconcile collections instantly and reduce manual bookkeeping errors.
As a store manager, I want to view a real-time 'ready for delivery' dashboard so that I can optimize delivery boy routes and reduce turnaround time.
As a business owner, I want to export monthly revenue reports in Excel/PDF format so that I can simplify my GST filing and accounting processes.
mvp_features: Digital Order Management: Create, edit, and track orders with item-level categorization (Dry Clean, Wash & Fold) to standardize operations.
Thermal Tag Printing: Bluetooth integration with portable thermal printers to print durable, heat-resistant garment tags for identification.
Automated Customer Notifications: Trigger transactional SMS/WhatsApp alerts for order confirmation, 'ready' status, and delivery completion.
Unified Payment Gateway: Integration with Razorpay/PhonePe to generate dynamic QR codes for instant UPI payments at the counter.
Staff Access Control: Role-based access for counter staff and washers to prevent unauthorized data modification and ensure accountability.
Basic Inventory Analytics: A dashboard showing daily order volume, pending deliveries, and total revenue collected to track business health.
future_features: Subscription Management: Recurring billing modules for monthly laundry packages to ensure predictable MRR.
Customer App: A branded consumer-facing app for users to book pickups and view order history.
AI-based Damage Detection: Integration with phone cameras to photograph garments during intake to dispute false claims of damage.
Route Optimization: Built-in mapping for delivery personnel to minimize travel time for doorstep pickup and drop-off services.
success_metrics: Churn Rate: < 5% monthly churn by month 6 — indicates product stickiness in a price-sensitive market.
Daily Active Users (DAU/MAU): > 70% by month 3 — measures the operational necessity of the tool for daily store functioning.
Digital Payment Adoption: > 60% of total transactions via integrated UPI by month 4 — validates the utility of the integrated payment feature.
Average On-time Delivery Rate: Increase of 20% within 3 months — proves the efficiency gain from status tracking features.
assumptions: Laundry owners possess at least one Android smartphone or tablet to run the application.
The target market is willing to pay a monthly SaaS fee if it demonstrably reduces manual labor and garment loss.
Users have access to reliable 4G internet connectivity at the shop location for real-time data syncing.
risks: Data privacy concerns under DPDP Act → Implement robust encryption and ensure data is localized on Indian servers (e.g., AWS Mumbai region).
High hardware friction for thermal printers → Offer a 'Hardware-as-a-Service' bundle to provide pre-configured, tested printers.
Resistance to digital adoption by legacy staff → Design a 'One-Tap' UI interface that requires minimal training to operate.
sections.go_to_market: Launch via direct sales and partnership with local laundry associations in Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities across India. Implement a 'freemium' model with a 14-day trial, supported by a referral program for existing owners to invite peers. The first 100 customers will be onboarded via high-touch concierge support to ensure successful configuration and training.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Use a No-Code/Low-Code stack like FlutterFlow for the front-end to ensure cross-platform iOS/Android support. Utilize Firebase for real-time database syncing and authentication, ensuring seamless offline-to-online data transition. Integrate Razorpay APIs for payment processing and Fast2SMS for cost-effective transactional messaging.
sections.monetisation: Tiered SaaS subscription: 'Starter' at ₹999/month for single-store, 'Growth' at ₹1,999/month for multi-store. The model relies on low-cost monthly recurring revenue (MRR) to ensure high retention. Future expansion revenue will come from value-added services like hardware leasing and premium data analytics dashboards.
